# Schiaparelli

> > Schiaparelli is a luxury fashion house featuring Daniel Roseberry's avant-garde collections with signature trompe l'oeil designs, anatomical motifs, and surrealist accessories.

Founded by Elsa Schiaparelli and revived under Creative Director Daniel Roseberry, the maison creates high-fashion ready-to-wear, accessories, and jewelry characterized by bold anatomical details, Keyhole motifs, Measure Ribbon embroidery, and surrealist elements. Each piece showcases meticulous craftsmanship with distinctive gold brass hardware and trompe l'oeil techniques.

## Key Topics

- Daniel Roseberry
- Elsa Schiaparelli
- Trompe l'oeil technique
- Anatomical design motifs
- Keyhole signature detail
- Measure Ribbon embroidery
- Surrealist fashion
- Gold brass hardware
- Lock and Anatomy buttons
- Face Bag collection
- Luxury haute couture
- Avant-garde design
- Zodiac jewelry
- High-fashion ready-to-wear
- Italian luxury craftsmanship
